newsitem.title: POLAND: Propeller decapitates mechanic at Warsaw airport.
newsitem.headline: Propeller decapitates mechanic at Warsaw airport.

text.p: An aircraft propeller cut off the head of a mechanic at Warsaw's Okecie airport, the Polish airline LOT said on Monday.

The 52-year-old mechanic died on Sunday. He was working on the wheel of an ATR-72 aircraft which had been given a permission to take off for the city of Poznan, LOT spokesman Andrzej Kazimierczak said.
"He (the mechanic) probably noticed that there was a blockage under a wheel. He tried to tear it out and that is when he died," the spokesman told PAP news agency.
The incident was being investigated, officials said.
